title: Even or odd
promptMd: Read one integer and print `even` if it is even, otherwise `odd`. Negative numbers and zero count too.

forbiddenPatterns.message: gets() is unsafe and removed from C — use fgets() instead.

hints: The remainder after dividing by 2 tells you the answer.
Careful with negative numbers: in some languages the remainder of a negative number is negative. Compare with 0 rather than with 1.
